history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-23, owner (borg-reborn-rs#1134 session): "We need zoo experiments with high concentration of poisionous animals, and try different settings"; earlier "another [issue] to test settings for preventing being poisoned fighting jelly and white worm masses" (borg-zoo#741).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, before any game of this build was played in this world (borg-zoo#741; borg-reborn-rs#1134, #1135, #1136, #1137; RULES 21).
Eight arms in poison-x8, each against ctl-x8: ctl (shipped); pkg (the owner's package: escape_phase_lost_danger_percent 50, caution_ranged_only 1,
caution_ranged_vs_immobile 2, caution_confused_clw_cure 1); ranged (caution_ranged_only 1; the white jelly is a ranged entry of
scary_monsters.txt); p934 (caution_poisoned_no_cure_retreat_hp_percent 75); osc (caution_retreat_oscillation_limit 3, _backaway 1); breeder5
(caution_breeder_policy 5 against the shipped 3: paths avoid colonies and the Borg walks out of a breeder room); buy (#1135:
town_prepared_poison_percent 40, town_prepared_ccw 2, town_prepared_ccw_percent 112); all (pkg without immobile2, plus p934, osc and buy).
The normal world is measured for the package by reborn-trackp-pkg-* (#738) and for ranged/immobile2 by #740; poison-x4 is defined in the
specimen for a later tier. Pilot (classes-18) as the gate, then verysmall (starts 1-45) in poison-x8.
Tier pilot: classes-18, 100,000 turns, poison-x8. Gate: no config_error; one binary; every cell records borg_world poison-x8 with the same borg_world_data_sha256;
each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays per
arm. Report per arm and class: deaths with poison apart (white/yellow jelly, worm masses, icky things, other), the killer, CL and depth at
death, rescued and newly killed against ctl-x8 (exact McNemar), DL3/DL5 reached, encounters with the six races, melee blows on them,
Neutralize Poison / CCW bought and quaffed. Descriptive (RULES 14).
